name: fx-tests
description: Command-line access to the Firefox test-health data behind https://tests.firefox.dev/
// bin: bin/fx-tests.js is a committed build artefact, not gitignored output. Node refuses to strip types under node_modules, so an installed package cannot run from .ts, and prepare cannot build one because npm runs it in a bare cache clone before devDependencies exist. Shipping the bundle is what makes the git-URL install work. `npm test` fails if it is stale.
// files: An install runs the self-contained bundle, so only it and the docs need to ship. Without this the tarball carries 4.5 MB of test fixtures and every dashboard .html, none of which the CLI reads.
// publishConfig: Not published to npm. `private: true` would block the git-URL install this is distributed by, so accidental publishing is prevented with a registry that refuses the request instead.
